function inputActivationCase(variant) {
 const checks={};if(typeof HTMLElement.prototype.click!=='function')return {click:false};
 const make=(type='checkbox')=>{const x=document.createElement('input');x.type=type;return x;};
 const holder=document.createElement('section');document.body.append(holder);const box=make();holder.append(box);box.indeterminate=true;const records=[];let original;
 for(const type of ['click','input','change'])box.addEventListener(type,e=>{if(type==='click')original=e;records.push({type,checked:box.checked,indeterminate:box.indeterminate,trusted:e.isTrusted,bubbles:e.bubbles,composed:e.composed,cancelable:e.cancelable,phase:original.eventPhase});});
 const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{});observer.observe(box,{attributes:true});box.click();
 checks.preActivation=records[0].checked&&!records[0].indeterminate;checks.order=records.map(e=>e.type).join(',')==='click,input,change';checks.state=box.checked&&!box.indeterminate;checks.trust=!records[0].trusted&&records[1].trusted&&records[2].trusted;checks.eventFlags=records[0].bubbles&&records[0].cancelable&&records[0].composed&&records[1].bubbles&&records[1].composed&&!records[1].cancelable&&records[2].bubbles&&!records[2].composed&&!records[2].cancelable;checks.clickBrand=original instanceof PointerEvent&&original.view===window&&original.pointerId===-1&&original.detail===0&&original.pointerType==='';checks.cleanupBeforeInput=records[1].phase===0&&records[2].phase===0;checks.noAttributes=observer.takeRecords().length===0;observer.disconnect();
 const canceled=make();holder.append(canceled);canceled.indeterminate=true;let during=false;let changes=0;canceled.addEventListener('click',e=>{during=canceled.checked&&!canceled.indeterminate;e.preventDefault()});canceled.addEventListener('input',()=>changes++);canceled.click();checks.cancelObserved=during;checks.cancelRestore=!canceled.checked&&canceled.indeterminate&&changes===0;canceled.defaultChecked=true;checks.cancelDirty=!canceled.checked;
 const detached=make();let detachedEvents=[];for(const type of ['click','input','change'])detached.addEventListener(type,()=>detachedEvents.push(type));detached.click();checks.detached=detached.checked&&detachedEvents.join(',')==='click';
 const disabled=make();holder.append(disabled);disabled.disabled=true;let disabledClicks=0;disabled.addEventListener('click',()=>disabledClicks++);disabled.click();checks.disabledClick=!disabled.checked&&disabledClicks===0;disabled.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));checks.disabledDispatch=disabled.checked&&disabledClicks===1;
 const synthetic=make();holder.append(synthetic);synthetic.dispatchEvent(new Event('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));checks.plainEvent=!synthetic.checked;synthetic.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{button:2}));checks.nonPrimary=!synthetic.checked;synthetic.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{button:0}));checks.mouseDispatch=synthetic.checked;synthetic.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('click',{button:0}));checks.pointerDispatch=!synthetic.checked;
 const dispatchCancel=make();dispatchCancel.addEventListener('click',e=>e.preventDefault());checks.dispatchCancel=!dispatchCancel.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{cancelable:true}))&&!dispatchCancel.checked;
 const reentrant=make();holder.append(reentrant);let clicks=0;reentrant.addEventListener('click',()=>{clicks++;reentrant.click()});reentrant.click();checks.reentrant=clicks===1&&reentrant.checked;
 const mutated=make();holder.append(mutated);let inputs=0;mutated.addEventListener('click',()=>{mutated.checked=false});mutated.addEventListener('input',()=>inputs++);mutated.click();checks.listenerState=!mutated.checked&&inputs===1;
 const typeChanged=make();holder.append(typeChanged);typeChanged.addEventListener('click',e=>{typeChanged.type='text';e.preventDefault()});typeChanged.click();checks.typeChange=typeChanged.checked&&typeChanged.type==='text';
 const a=make('radio'),b=make('radio');a.name=b.name='activation-'+variant;holder.append(a,b);a.defaultChecked=true;let radioClicks=0,radioInputs=0;a.addEventListener('click',()=>radioClicks++);a.addEventListener('input',()=>radioInputs++);a.click();checks.radioAlready=radioClicks===1&&radioInputs===0&&a.checked;
 let radioDuring=false;b.addEventListener('click',e=>{radioDuring=!a.checked&&b.checked;e.preventDefault()},{once:true});b.click();checks.radioPre=radioDuring;checks.radioCancel=a.checked&&!b.checked;b.click();checks.radioSelect=!a.checked&&b.checked;
 const movedA=make('radio'),movedB=make('radio');movedA.name=movedB.name='moved-'+variant;holder.append(movedA,movedB);movedA.checked=true;movedB.addEventListener('click',e=>{movedA.name='away-'+variant;e.preventDefault()});movedB.click();checks.radioMoved=!movedA.checked&&movedB.checked;
 const noPrevious=make('radio');holder.append(noPrevious);noPrevious.addEventListener('click',e=>e.preventDefault());noPrevious.click();checks.radioNoPrevious=!noPrevious.checked;
 const unnamed=make('radio');unnamed.checked=true;unnamed.addEventListener('click',e=>e.preventDefault());unnamed.click();checks.radioUnnamed=unnamed.checked;
 const fieldset=document.createElement('fieldset'),legend=document.createElement('legend'),second=document.createElement('legend');fieldset.setAttribute('disabled','');fieldset.append(legend,second);holder.append(fieldset);const exempt=make(),blocked=make(),secondBlocked=make();legend.append(exempt);second.append(secondBlocked);fieldset.append(blocked);exempt.click();blocked.click();secondBlocked.click();checks.firstLegend=exempt.checked;checks.fieldsetDisabled=!blocked.checked&&!secondBlocked.checked;
 const inner=document.createElement('fieldset');inner.setAttribute('disabled','');legend.append(inner);const nested=make();inner.append(nested);nested.click();checks.nestedDisabled=!nested.checked;
 const ordinary=document.createElement('div');holder.append(ordinary);let ordinaryCount=0;ordinary.addEventListener('click',()=>ordinaryCount++);checks.genericClick=ordinary.click()===undefined&&ordinaryCount===1;
 let rejected=false;try{HTMLElement.prototype.click.call(document.createTextNode('x'))}catch(e){rejected=e instanceof TypeError}checks.receiver=rejected;const descriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLElement.prototype,'click');checks.method=descriptor.enumerable&&descriptor.configurable&&descriptor.writable&&HTMLElement.prototype.click.length===0;
 const forged=make();holder.append(forged);forged.dispatchEvent(Reflect.construct(UIEvent,['click'],PointerEvent));checks.reflectedUI=!forged.checked;
 holder.remove();return checks;
}
